confirmed_task:
On Homebrew Formulae, open the ffmpeg formula. Report its stable version, license, every package listed under Depends on, and whether binary bottles are displayed for macOS on Apple Silicon and for Linux.

Stopping condition: Stop after the stable version, license, complete regular dependency list, and bottle availability for both requested platforms have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not download or install the formula.
- Use the regular Depends on section; exclude build-only dependencies and items under Uses from macOS.
- Report bottle availability exactly as displayed.

items.criterion: Use Homebrew Formulae ffmpeg page (specified source) without downloading/installing
items.description: Attempt to access the Homebrew Formulae page for the ffmpeg formula (e.g., https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/ffmpeg) and extract information from that page only, without downloading or installing the formula. Full credit if the agent uses the page as the primary source OR if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but is blocked (e.g., CAPTCHA), the site is down, or the content fails to load, and it clearly reports this limitation. Partial credit if the agent uses an alternative source only after encountering access issues with the formulae page and explains why. No credit if the agent fabricates details without any basis or claims to have accessed the page when it did not.

items.criterion: Record stable version exactly as displayed
items.description: Report the stable version for ffmpeg from the formula page, matching what is displayed in the stable version field. Full credit if it matches exactly as displayed OR if the stable version field is not visible due to access/loading issues and the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the page. Partial credit if a version is provided but is not clearly labeled as stable or appears truncated/incomplete despite the page being accessible.

Report the license for ffmpeg from the formula page, matching what is displayed (including multi-license formatting). Full credit if it matches exactly as displayed OR if the license field is not visible due to access/loading issues and the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the page. Partial credit if the license is close but not exact/complete when the page is accessible.

items.criterion: List all regular 'Depends on' packages (excluding build-only and 'Uses from macOS')
items.description: From the formula page, list every package shown under the regular 'Depends on' section. Must exclude (a) build-only dependencies and (b) any items under 'Uses from macOS'. Full credit if the dependency list is complete and contains only the regular 'Depends on' packages exactly as shown OR if the Depends on section is not accessible/visible due to page access/loading issues and the agent clearly states it cannot retrieve the dependency list from the page. Partial credit if 1–2 dependencies are missed or if a small number of excluded items (build-only/'Uses from macOS') are mistakenly included when the section is visible.

items.criterion: Report bottle availability for macOS Apple Silicon exactly as displayed
items.description: State whether binary bottles are displayed as available for macOS on Apple Silicon, matching the wording/status shown on the formula page (i.e., the Apple Silicon/macOS platform line as displayed). Full credit if the availability/status is captured exactly as displayed OR if the bottles section (or the Apple Silicon line) is not visible due to access/loading issues and the agent explicitly states it cannot be confirmed from the page. Partial credit if the correct platform is addressed but the status wording is not exact when visible.

items.criterion: Report bottle availability for Linux exactly as displayed
items.description: State whether binary bottles are displayed as available for Linux, matching the wording/status shown on the formula page (i.e., the Linux platform line as displayed). Full credit if the availability/status is captured exactly as displayed OR if the bottles section (or Linux line) is not visible due to access/loading issues and the agent explicitly states it cannot be confirmed from the page. Partial credit if Linux is addressed but the status wording is not exact when visible.

items.criterion: Stop at requested information only (respect stopping condition and scope constraints)
items.description: End the task after recording stable version, license, complete regular dependency list, and bottle availability for macOS Apple Silicon and Linux—without adding extra unrelated formula details. Full credit if the response stays within scope; do not include build-only dependencies or 'Uses from macOS'. Partial credit if minor extra info is included but all required items are still correctly reported and exclusions are respected. No credit if the agent substantially exceeds scope or repeatedly violates exclusions despite them being visible on the page.
